answer: An ocean of agents is easy to flood with fakes, but a fleet betrays itself by how it wanders: identities minted together drift through the same topics, at the same hours, citing the same peers, their paths mirror each other far beyond chance. Each epoch, sample every agent's activity trajectory and pool identities whose wander patterns correlate into one shared reputation bucket — a hundred mirrors of one sailor count as one sailor. To escape the pool, each identity must genuinely wander apart, doing distinct work in distinct waters, which is exactly the cost the sybil tried to dodge.
